text: The Manager, Electric Vehicle Charging Program, Toronto Atmospheric Fund will give a presentation on Zero-Emission Vehicle Infrastructure Program Update. This presentation will provide an overview of the current status and future plans for the Zero-Emission Vehicle Infrastructure Program (ZEVIP) including program background, goals, offering for funding recipients, and implementation timeline. Staff can respond to questions and are seeking connections with organizations who might be interested securing funding for the installation of Electric Vehicle (EV) charging stations in public locations, multi-unit residential buildings and on-street locations.
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund received the item for information.
